definitions.explanation: The most important or central part of something. The key points that summarize the essence.

examples.japanese: {要点|ようてん}をまとめてください。
{要点|ようてん}を{押|お}さえましょう。
{話|はなし}の{要点|ようてん}が{分|わ}かりません。
examples.english: I don't understand the gist of what you're saying.

notes:
{要点|ようてん} refers to the main points or essentials.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {要点|ようてん}をまとめる (summarize the main points)
- {要点|ようてん}を{押|お}さえる (grasp the key points)
- {要点|ようてん}を{整理|せいり}する (organize the main points)
- {要点|ようてん}{筆記|ひっき} (note-taking of key points)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ポイント: point (loanword, casual)
- {要点|ようてん}: main point (formal)
- {概要|がいよう}: summary, outline
- {要旨|ようし}: gist, summary (written)
